description: Team_VanGuard is a student team in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, tackling how farms can adapt to changing climate conditions using NASA Earth data.
summary: Developed HarvestV, an agricultural web application supporting farmers with accessible information, rotation planning, and a constantly self-improving system. With an easily understandable user interface, a powerful and well-equipped rotation planning system, HarvestV aims to be a farmers go-to assistant for agricultural support.
details: Harvest V is an agricultural decision-support platform designed to help farmers make informed crop rotation decisions using environmental data and crop-specific information. The system aims to integrate NASA POWER climate data with agricultural datasets to evaluate crop suitability and suggest effective crop rotation strategies. By providing data-driven insights through a user-friendly interface, Harvest V aims to support sustainable farming practices, improve resource management, and promote better agricultural planning.
